title: Vibrant Elote Bowl
description: A colorful and flavorful Mexican-inspired bowl filled with vibrant vegetables and a delicious elote sauce. Perfect for a light lunch or dinner.
instructions: Grill the elote for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until slightly charred.
Meanwhile, cook the Mexican rice according to package instructions.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked rice, grilled elote, peas, vibrant vegetables, and sliced avocado.
In a small bowl, whisk together the lime juice and queso fresco until smooth.
Pour the lime dressing over the bowl and toss to combine.
Sprinkle chopped cilantro on top and serve immediately.
